chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْوَشَّاءِ، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَائِذٍ، عَنْ أَبِي خَدِيجَةَ الْجَمَّالِ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Abdallah ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha, from Ahmad ibn A'idh, from Abi Khadija the Cameleer who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَقُولُ: إِنِّي سَأَلْتُ اللَّهَ فِي إِسْمَاعِيلَ أَنْ يَبْقِيَهُ بَعْدِي فَأَبَىٰ، وَلَكِنَّهُ قَدْ أَعْطَانِي فِيهِ مَنْزِلَةً أُخْرَىٰ، إِنَّهُ يَكُونُ أَوَّلَ مَنْشُورٍ فِي عَشَرَةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، وَمِنْهُمْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ شَرِيكٍ، وَهُوَ صَاحِبُ لِوَائِهِ

translations.en: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: I asked Allah regarding Ismail that He should preserve him to remain after me, but He refused, however, He has given me another position for him, he will be the first one to be resurrected with ten of his companions, among them Abdallah ibn Sharik, and he will be the man who carries his banner.

en.summary: In this narration from Al-Kashi’s *Rijal*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that while Ismail ibn Ja'far did not survive him, he was granted the distinct honor of being the first of the ten *Manshurun* (resurrected ones) to rise on the Day of Judgment. This event is closely associated with the Mahdi, as Abdallah ibn Sharik is identified as the bearer of Ismail’s banner, symbolizing his leadership among the early resurrected companions.
en.seo_question: Who is the first person to be resurrected among the companions of Imam Ismail according to Rijal al-Kashshi?

key_terms.إِسْمَاعِيلَ: Ismail, referring to Ismail ibn Ja'far
key_terms.أَوَّلَ مَنْشُورٍ: The first one to be resurrected/raised from the dead
